title: Pre-treatment Tumor Volume Growth Rate and Baseline Volume Measured by an Artificial Intelligence Program Predict Overall Survival in Patients With Pleural Mesothelioma Undergoing Deferred Systemic Th
summary: single-center retrospective cohort of 71 mesothelioma patients with serial pretreatment CT; an AI segmentation program measured tumor volumes/growth rates; Cox/Kaplan-Meier analyses found associations with overall survival. A bounded prognostic association, not causal or external validation. Published in JTO Clinical and Research Reports.
